scopeNotes: The exact local PUB-01 export was used as the visual source reference; no reference image was copied into runtime assets and no production content was fabricated.

The homepage consumes only GET /api/v1/public/home and existing /properties navigation. It renders only the public projection and never exposes provider, assignment, audit, moderation, or private-document fields.

The nine new homepage snapshots verify the current fail-closed SSR shell and responsive structure. Populated CMS visual data is consumed when a configured non-production WEB_API_ORIGIN provides the existing contract.
The existing public-properties-zh-CN-mobile snapshot was regenerated by the selected visual command and preserved as a generated test artifact.
